name.en: 30MS OPTION PARTS SET 25 (TURBO COSTUME γ) [COLOR C]

ja: ■印刷されていないフェイスパーツ2個に加え、頭部パーツ(FP-I型)が2種類付属。「30 MINUTES SISTERS 水転写式デカール 汎用」(別売り)との組み合わせで表情豊かなキャラメイキングを実現！
■ヘアスタイルパーツとヘルメットが付属。
■腕、脚に装着可能なリングタイプのジョイントパーツも多数付属。
■「30 MINUTES SISTERS」はフェイスパーツ/ヘアスタイルパーツ/ボディパーツを部位ごとにラインアップ展開。別売りのパーツと組み替えて自分好みのシスターを創ることができる。
■30 MINUTES LABEL共通の3mmジョイントを採用。「30 MINUTES MISSIONS」のパーツもオプションとして装着が可能。(※「30 MINUTES MISSIONS」キットの対象年齢は8才以上です)
en: • In addition to 2 unprinted face parts, 2 types of head parts (FP-I type) are included. In combination with "30 MINUTES SISTERS Water Transfer Decal General Purpose" (sold separately), you can create expressive characters!
• Hair style parts and helmet included.
• Many ring-type joint parts that can be attached to arms and legs are also included.
• "30 MINUTES SISTERS" offers a lineup of face parts, hairstyle parts, and body parts by body part. You can create your own sister by combining parts sold separately.
• Adopts 3mm joint common to 30 MINUTES LABEL. "30 MINUTES MISSIONS " parts can also be installed as options. (*" 30 MINUTES MISSIONS" Kit is for ages 8 and up)
